title: Long-horizon Video Generation with Slot Memory Addressed By Region Tokens
title_zh: 通过区域令牌实现的槽式记忆：长时程视频生成研究

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种名为SMART的槽式记忆机制，通过区域令牌实现，能够在保持有限存储的同时提供基于空间的回忆能力。 Memory for long-horizon video generation must satisfy two competing requirements: it must remain bounded so generation can continue indefinitely, while still recovering what was observed at a place when the camera returns, regardless of how long ago it was seen. Reconstruction-based memories provide spatial recall by caching and reprojecting explicit geometry, but require growing storage and depend on estimated 3D structure. Recurrent memories keep a constant-size state, but retention is governed by temporal recurrence, causing old observations to fade with time. We introduce SMART, a slot memory addressed by region tokens, which combines bounded storage with spatially addressed recall. SMART stores content in a constant-size slot recurrence whose writes are addressed by the observing camera and whose reads are queried by the rendering camera, without constructing an explicit 3D representation or maintaining a growing cache. Consequently, recall is conditioned on inter-view geometry rather than on recency. Each read additionally provides a confidence estimate that conditions a chunk-causal diffusion transformer, allowing it to selectively trust retrieved content while relying on its generative prior elsewhere. On long trajectories in Memory Maze and Minecraft, SMART maintains high-fidelity recall far beyond its training horizon while using constant memory and per-step cost.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种名为SMART的槽式记忆机制，通过区域令牌实现，能够在保持有限存储的同时提供基于空间的回忆能力。长时程视频生成所需的记忆必须满足两个相互冲突的要求：它必须保持有限容量，以便生成过程可以无限延续；同时，无论观察内容是在多久之前发生的，当摄像头返回到同一位置时，仍需能够恢复当时所观察到的内容。 基于重建的记忆通过缓存并重新投影显式几何信息来实现空间回忆，但需要不断扩展存储容量，并且依赖于估计的三维结构。 循环记忆保持恒定大小的状态，但其保留能力受时间上的重复性控制，导致旧有观察内容会随时间逐渐消退。 我们提出了SMART，一种由区域令牌寻址的槽式记忆机制，它将有限存储与基于空间的回忆能力相结合。 SMART将内容存储在恒定大小的槽式循环结构中：写入操作由观察摄像头寻址，读取操作则由渲染摄像头查询，而无需构建显式的三维表示或维护不断增长的缓存。 因此，回忆能力取决于不同视角间的几何关系，而非内容的时效性。 每次读取还会提供一个置信度估计值，该值用于约束块因果扩散变换器，使其能够选择性信任检索到的内容，同时在其他部分依赖其生成先验知识。 在Memory Maze和Minecraft中的长轨迹任务中，SMART能够在远超训练时程的情况下保持高保真度的回忆能力，同时仅使用恒定内存和每步固定成本。
